answer: In the den, every sable molts at payout, and its pelt is laid out for inspection. Each pelt carries an ivory tag, and the nectar it was fed stains the fur a distinct shade. Every identity backs its claim with a 1,600,000 POA stake. Two identical pelts belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 700,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 2,300,000 POA, and three fakes cost 6,900,000 POA before any payout clears.
